study type: Quasi-experimental interventional study (before-and-after design) with retrospective and prospective data collection
cohort: The study included 366 hysterectomies performed at a developed country's reference center and 663 hysterectomies performed at a public reference service in a developing country.
finding: High-quality laparoscopic training in a world-renowned specialized center significantly improved the technicity index (TI) in the recipient's developing country center from 6% to 22%, leading to comparable surgical outcomes for hospital stay length and complication rate, though operative time and blood loss during surgery remained significantly shorter in the host center.
cross-section timing: Host center: 2017; Home center pre-training data: 2010-2013; Home center post-training data: 2015-2017
